translated_title: Mauricio Kuri, Governor of Querétaro, Did Not Notify the Secretariat of Foreign Relations of Inviting the US Ambassador to a Ceremony, Sheinbaum Says
original_title: Mauricio Kuri, gobernador de Querétaro, no notificó a SRE de invitación al embajador de EU a ceremonia: Sheinbaum
author: Alonso Urrutia and Emir Olivares
meta_description: States can receive training and equipment from abroad, Sheinbaum said, but it all has to go through the federal government, and this ceremony skipped it.
